decision: D-025 (option A; was O-19): Uninstall does not delete Directive's local state (.deft/*.json state, .deft-cache/, .deft-scratch/, .deft-run-summary.json) or the tracked policy files (.deft/forward-coverage.allow, .deft/test-boundary.policy.json, .deft/settings.json); plan and report list them under Kept, exit 0. Uninstall warns by name about every registered git worktree under .deft-scratch/. Separately, #6603 (held, polfer) moves live worktrees out of .deft-scratch/; removing the housekeeping folders on uninstall is a later RC after that.
